entries.title: run_check must survive malformed check commands: an unbalanced quote makes shlex.split raise ValueError outside the try/except, killing the whole night with halt_reason=error; catch it and return a failing CheckResult (ok=False, exit_code=-1) instead

Shell-form pytest checks bypass the documented addopts strip: needs_shell commands like 'pytest tests/test_ok.py -q && echo ok' run under /bin/sh without -o addopts=, so a pytest.ini --cov still kills the check; insert -o addopts= after each pytest invocation in the shell branch, matching the README safety contract
ADR + assumptions gate: document the project's decisions and assumptions
entries.note: Non-negotiable, runs first. Read the COMPLETE project in the snapshot (code, tests, config, README, docs, git log) before writing. Write retrospective ADRs in docs/adr/: one file per real, load-bearing decision visible in code, config, commits or existing docs. Never invent a decision. Any rationale not stated in code, docs or commits is labelled '(inferred)'. Each ADR cites its evidence (file paths, commit hashes). Match the format already used in docs/adr/. Keep docs/adr/README.md as an index table linking every ADR. Write docs/assumptions.md as an assumptions register: a table with ID, Assumption, Evidence, Stated/Inferred, Impact if wrong, Review owner. Gaps at freeze: no assumptions register under docs/ (e.g. docs/assumptions.md)
